# Security Policy

If you find a security vulnerability in this project, please do not open a public issue.

Instead, report it privately through GitHub's private security advisory process:

https://github.com/thatdaveguy1/docker-wyze-bridge/security/advisories

Please include:

- a short description of the issue
- affected versions or commits
- clear reproduction steps
- any suggested mitigation if you have one

Reports are acknowledged as soon as possible, and fixes are coordinated before public disclosure.
